summary: Iteration 8 fix-round verification of SocietyHub rentals. Ran a new pytest suite (23 tests) against the public preview URL covering PUT /api/rentals/payments/{pid} and PUT /api/rentals/payouts/{pid} reference enforcement, the new master-based carry-forward fallback with unit_state() guard, carry-forward with a saved previous bill, and rentals regression (bills list, statement, receipt PDF, month validation, auth). 22/23 passed. Frontend: verified Collections keeps mode=Cash after a successful collection (fix works) and Payouts default category; the Payouts default was WRONG in the live DB ('Common electricity') because the 'Maintenance' category row is missing - after re-seeding it the default correctly shows 'Maintenance', so the frontend regex is fine and the defect is the non-idempotent category seeding in the backend.

minor.issue: DEFAULT_CATEGORIES are only inserted when the collection is completely empty. 'Maintenance' had been deleted, so it never came back; this silently broke the Payouts default-category preference (fell back to cats[0]='Common electricity'). Upsert each default on every list call (or block deleting defaults).

prev_outstanding() fallback creates dues for months before the unit existed when the unit has no lease_start (status active => unit_state()='active' for any past month). A unit created today with rent 10000 + maint 500 and no lease dates shows carry_forward 10500 for the previous month. Suggest also guarding on lease_start presence / created_at month.

integration_issues.issue: Default category showed 'Common electricity' in the live environment because the 'Maintenance' master row is absent from rental_categories (backend seeding issue). Frontend logic verified correct after re-seeding.

action_items: Make rental_categories seeding idempotent (upsert every DEFAULT_CATEGORIES entry on list_categories) so 'Maintenance' always exists; otherwise the Payouts default-category fix is ineffective in real DBs.
Decide/implement behaviour for units with no lease_start: currently they get carry_forward from the master for arbitrary past months (bogus dues for newly created units).

Stale test: /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_carry_reference.py::TestBillEditAndCarry::test_draft_uses_master_amounts_and_zero_carry now contradicts the intended master fallback (its unit has no lease_start) and also depends on class execution order under xdist; update it once the above behaviour is decided.
critical_code_review_comments: rentals.py: prev_outstanding() calls unit_state(), which is defined later inside make_router — works via closure but is fragile; move unit_state to module level next to month_bounds.

require_reference() only whitelists literal 'cash'; any new mode string added to /lib/modes.js will silently require a reference. Consider validating mode against an allowed set (cash/upi/bank) with 400 on unknown mode.
rentals.py is 754 lines — consider splitting bills/payments/payouts/statement into modules.
seed_data_creation: Re-created the missing 'Maintenance' rental category via POST /api/rentals/categories (needed to validate the Payouts default). Test units/payments/payouts created under months 2028-05/2028-06 were deleted by fixtures. One UI-created ₹111 cash collection on Sai orchid A2 (2026-08) was deleted through the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_carry_fallback_reference.py (uses months 2028-05/2028-06, creates and deletes its own units). Verified: PUT payments/payouts reject non-cash without reference (incl. whitespace-only) and accept cash / is_credit; fallback carry = master rent+maint - payments in prev month; 0 for upcoming lease, vacant, ended lease; saved-bill partial => +6000, overpay => -2000 reflected in bills and statement. Only open backend gaps: default-category seeding and no-lease_start units getting carry-forward.
rca_of_the_issue: Payouts default category: list_categories() seeds DEFAULT_CATEGORIES only when rental_categories is empty. A previous iteration deleted the 'Maintenance' row, so /rentals/categories no longer returns it and Payouts.jsx's /maintenance/i lookup falls back to cats[0]. Fix = per-name upsert of defaults. Carry-forward bogus dues: unit_state() returns 'active' for any month when lease_start is empty and status='active', so the master fallback bills months that predate the unit.
